patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the package so the patched game installs beside the original. Unity resolves its string resources by package name, so the resource table is renamed together with the manifest.

options.title: Change package name
options.description: Install next to the original game instead of replacing it. The clone uses its own data and save, and can never touch the original account.

options.title: New package name
options.description: Package name of the clone. Must not be the original package name.

patches.name: Offline single-player
patches.description: Patches libil2cpp.so so The Tower starts and saves without Firebase/PlayFab/Play login, skips the ad/analytics SDK startup calls, fixes the server clock, makes gem packs grant their gems when tapped, and shows the real gem amounts in the shop. Only for v29.0.6 (build 1237).

patches.name: Offline tournaments (experimental)
patches.description: Removes the "no internet" gate on the tournament button/panel, starts attempts locally and makes joining succeed without the server. Leaderboards and rewards that need the server still do not exist offline. Turn this off if tournaments misbehave.

patches.name: Seed Remote Config cache
patches.description: Copies the bundled Firebase Remote Config cache into the app on first start. Without it SaveLoad.Load fails offline (no shop/mini boss config), so the game never saves.
